state:
**Goal `ext-image-analysis` — `Novis\Image` compares, hashes, summarises and draws. Stages 2 to 5 are on disk: comparison, hashing, placeholders, the palette, QR codes and text. Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is not.**

The design is ADR 0120 §§ 8 and 9, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets, the crates included. No session re-decides one.

Stage 5 on disk: `extensions/image/src/text.rs` (module doc: size is the em in pixels, line height, `GPOS` `kern`-feature pair kerning read through `ttf-parser` with the `kern` table as fallback, `maxWidth` breaks at spaces and never inside a word, `align`, the box, the source drawn opaque black) is `Op::Text` and `Input::Text`; `Image::text`, `Image::measureText` (a `text` source run to the `size` output) and `Font::fromBytes` (checks the first four bytes in Novis) in `extensions/image/nvs/`; the manifest's text shapes are `x: ?T` per `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`. The four host checks are in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs` over the fixture `extensions/image/fixtures/DancingScript-Regular.ttf` (OFL, beside its licence), and `tests/conformance/novis/image-font-from-bytes-refuses-bytes-that-are-not-a-font.nvst` pins the `ParseError`s. Both rule fragments' *Not shipped* paragraphs say what is on disk.

The component's own unit tests run with `cargo test --lib` inside `extensions/image/`, a workspace of its own. `cargo deny check bans` fails on a `nvs-image` wildcard dev-dependency that was already there before this goal; `cargo deny check licenses` was not re-run for `ab_glyph`, `ab_glyph_rasterizer`, `owned_ttf_parser` and `ttf-parser` (all Apache-2.0 or MIT, not checked).

**The text members' proofs** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`) — `Image::text`, `Image::measureText` and `Font::fromBytes` at `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:244`, `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:260` and `extensions/image/nvs/Font.nvs:17`; first check the roster in `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:1` now lists them, since the driver's last sweep said it did not.

**The other members this goal added** — `compare`, `hash`, `hashDistance`, `placeholder`, `palette`, `QrCode::render`, whatever `bun nv proofs --owed` still names under `Novis\Image`, beside `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:295`.

backlog: `cargo deny check licenses` over the text crates, and the pre-existing `nvs-image` wildcard dev-dependency `cargo deny check bans` names (`deny.toml`).
An example that draws text needs a font the program reads itself: an example or attack under `docs/examples/` has to ship one, and the fixture's OFL allows it (`extensions/image/fixtures/README.md`).
Complex shaping (`rustybuzz`) is a later wave per ADR 0120 § 9; the reference card for `Image::text` must say Latin only.
